info.name: Homeward Offer Estimate
info.description:
Offer Estimate API Documentation

This document outlines the Homeward API for seller leads and is exclusively for use by Homeward cash offer digital partners.

Have questions? Email us at api@homeward.com

For testing endpoint credentials email us at: api@homeward.com

API Integration

Homeward Delivery of Offer Estimate PDF for partner use: Upon receiving the offer request, we respond to the API submission with Homeward Offer Estimate details for the partner to display in-app with a link to Homeward Offer Estimate PDF.

Authentication

We use token authentication. Contact us using the methods described above to get a testing and production token, which you can use in an Authentication header to use all of the endpoints below.

request.description:
An Offer Request is defined as a request from a partner to receive a Homeward Offer Estimate. This is posted from Partner to Homeward.

Request

Field Type Required? Description
partner_offer_request_id string yes Unique ID configured by the partner
street_one string yes Street address
street_two string no Unit information
city string yes
state string yes standard 2-letter state abbreviation
postal_code string yes Just postal code, no +4 identifier
customer_first_name string yes
customer_last_name string yes
customer_email string yes Must be a unique email
customer_phone string no
agent_first_name string no
agent_last_name string no
agent_email string no
agent_phone string no
bedrooms integer no
bathrooms string no
home_size_sq_ft integer no
outstanding_loan_amount integer no
agent_opinion_of_value integer no
home_listing_status string no If the home already listed on MLS, select from the following:
- Coming Soon
- Listed
- Expired
- Withdrawn
- Cancelled
- Under Contract
- Sold
home_stories integer no Number of stories the house has
master_on_main boolean no Is the master bedroom on the main floor?
additions_made boolean no Has the current homeowner made additions?
addition_sqft integer no Approximate sq footage of any additions
has_basement boolean no Does the property have a basement?
basement_sqft integer no Approximate sq ft of basement
kitchen_countertop_type string no Choose from:
corian, formica, granite, granite tile, other tile, Quartz
boolean no
garage_spaces_count integer no Number of cars that can fit in the garage (exclude if no garage)
hvac_age integer no Age of the hvac system in years
repair_or_update_detail string no Open text for any repairs or updates the homeowner has made
photos array of strings no
property_type string no Choose from:
Single Family, Unknown, Multi-Family, Luxury, Condo, Lot, Other, Commercial, Mobile Home, Townhouse, Timeshare
has_solar_panels boolean no Does the property currently have solar panels?
year_built integer no
lot_size_acres integer no

Response

Response Status Codes

2xx - everything is OK
4xx - the request Homeward made was invalid
5xx - the request may have been valid, but something went wrong on our side

Additional Information

If an address is denied an offer estimate, the reason_for_denial field will contain a string with information on why the address was rejected. In this case, the offer_amount, expiration_date, preliminary_offer_pdf, and offer_finalization_link fields will also be null. If an offer estimate is created, the reason_for_denial will be null and the other fields will contain values.

reason_for_denial can be any of the following:

  • Estimated sale price is outside of buybox

  • Property lot size is outside of buybox

  • Property type is outside of buybox

  • Year built it outside of buybox

  • Property type 'Townhouse' is outside of buybox

  • Property type 'Multi-Family' is outside of buybox

  • Property type 'Luxury' is outside of buybox

  • Property type 'Condo' is outside of buybox

  • Property type 'Lot' is outside of buybox

  • Property type 'Other is outside of buybox

  • Property type 'Commercial' is outside of buybox

  • Property type 'MobileHome' is outside of buybox

  • Property type 'Timeshare' is outside of buybox

  • Property type 'Unknown' is outside of buybox

  • Listing status is outside of buybox

The offer_finalization_link field above has the following two url options:

  1. If agent information was provided, the link will create a viewable application within the agent’s Homeward dashboard and route that agent to their dashboard. If the agent does not have an account with Homeward, it will prompt them to create an account.

  2. If no agent information was provided, the link will send the agent to a Homeward page prompting the agent to either sign-in or create an account with Homeward. This process will add the agent to the offer and route them to their Homeward dashboard.

Field Type Description
partner_offer_request_id string Unique key provided by partner in the request
homeward_offer_id string Unique key provided by Homeward
offer_amount integer
expiration_date string
preliminary_offer_pdf string Url to download a preliminary offer PDF
offer_finalization_link string Url to finalize an offer
reason for denial string Included if offer request is denied

request.description:
We’ve created this endpoint as a way to do a quick check on whether or not a given property is within Homeward’s buybox. This is not meant to provide a definitive determination, but instead is to provide a method for partners to quickly determine whether or not a property is likely within Homeward’s buybox.

The reasons an Offer Estimate eligibility outcome could be different is incomplete data provided here (eg, optional fields not provided), or from different values in the underlying datasets Homeward uses to evaluate properties, in which case Homeward will always rely on our trusted data sources for Offer Estimate outcomes.

Note: Due to its high-traffic nature, this endpoint is totally separate from the rest of our API, does not require a credential, and has a different base url and path format than the rest of the API.

Request

All fields in the payload are optional, with the exception of the state field, which is required. ​​The more values provided, the more accurate the buy-box eligibility will be.

Level Key Type Required? Description
property_address street_one string no
property_address street_two string no
property_address city string no
property_address state string yes standard 2-letter state abbreviation
property_address postal_code string no
opinion_of_value integer no
lot_size_acres integer no
property_type string no Choose from:
Single Family, Unknown, Multi-Family, Luxury, Condo, Lot, Other, Commercial, Mobile Home, Townhouse, Timeshare
listing_status string no Choose from:
Listed, Not Listed, Unknown
year_built integer or string no

Response

If the request is successful, the response will always include a field called is_eligible that is set to a Boolean, along with reason_for_denial, which will only be populated, if we are unable to validate any of the property information, the reason will be included in the field reason_for_denial.

Additional Information

reason_for_denial can be any of the following:

  • Property lot size is outside of buybox

  • Year built is outside of buybox

  • Listing status is outside of buybox

    • If you're receiving this error, please ensure you're posting a value in line with our stated statuses

  • Estimated sale price outside of buybox

  • Property type is outside of buybox

  • Property address outside of buybox

response.name: Property is not eligible

request.description:
Update offer request agent details

This endpoint allows updating the real estate agent details for a specific partner offer request. The provided offer_request_id can be the partner_offer_request_id provided when creating the Offer Request resource, or the homeward_offer_id returned with the creation of the Offer Request.

Request

All fields in the request are optional, but the entire agent resource will be replaced with the information provided.

Field Type Required Description
first_name string no
last_name string no
email string no
phone string no 10 digit phone number with area code. Accepted formats:
999-888-7777
(999) 888-7777
999.888.7777
9998887777

Response Status Codes

200 - the resource was updated
4XX - the request is invalid
5XX - the request may have been valid, but something went wrong on our side

Response

The response will be a JSON object that includes all the information from the Offer Request POST response, but with the following included:

  • agent (object): An object containing the updated agent details with the following properties:

    • first_name (string): The first name of the agent.

    • last_name (string): The last name of the agent.

    • email (string): The email address of the agent.

    • phone (string): The phone number of the agent.

The response of this request can be documented as a JSON schema.
